done_when: close runs the release-checkout sync test (or forge sync --check) when a change touches the workflow generator or the templates and fails with one line naming the file to regenerate; and when the pinned release is newer than the newest published tag in Forge's own repo, close runs Forge from the source checkout instead of failing; new and existing repos get it on upgrade
why: A change to the workflow generator (prcheck.py or the templates) can merge without the regenerated .github/workflows/forge.yml, which turns main red (it happened on 18 Nov 2026), and after a release bump merges, a branch that merges main pins a release that is not published yet, so close fails with 'Failed to resolve --with requirement' until the release is out
